description: Installs and configures the Skills Repo Manager module — collects skills repo root and git-pull preference

Pulls each registered repo (git pull --ff-only, never modifies sources), clones any not yet checked out (--clone-missing), adapts skills into BMad structure, and materializes them as prefixed skills — then prunes stale mappings.
Registers an external skill repo — auto-detects its layout (grouped BMad module or flat skills dir) and asks what prefix to prepend to mapped skills.
Lists registered repos with their prefixes and last-sync status.
Unregisters a repo and removes its mapped skills from the project.
Shows freshness of each mapped skill versus its source commit.
